missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: No compatible previous_move_causality exists for selected/candidate intent.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 直前手との直接の因果が確認できていません。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Available support is absent or geometry-only.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 形の近さ以外の根拠が十分ではありません。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: More than one material Intent candidate remains close enough that existing confidence is LOW/UNRESOLVED.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 複数の狙いが候補に残っています。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Resolver output is LOW due to weak/unclear lead; do not expose raw score unless UI explicitly supports diagnostics.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 主な狙いを一つに絞る根拠がまだ弱い状態です。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Engine comparison exists but comparisonStable is false.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 候補手比較が安定していないため、評価差を理由として使えません。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Claim class requires alternative-line proof but stable counterfactual is absent.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 別の手との比較が不足しており、目的までは確認できません。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Timing/sabai/plan-like claim requires multi-ply continuity but only local effect is confirmed.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 数手先まで続く働きが確認できていません。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Specialized explanation requires reference-backed cue but no validated reference record is present.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 専門的な定跡・戦型根拠を確認できていません。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Specialized provider candidate exists but one or more required evidence gates fail.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 専門的な説明に必要な盤面・手順の根拠が不足しています。

missingEvidenceReasons.emitWhen: Available observation is an Effect/Outcome but requested wording would require Intent.
missingEvidenceReasons.safeText: 確認できるのは結果までで、狙いまでは断定できません。

fallbackOrder: Use grounded specific why-now when safe.
Otherwise use existing selectedIntent wording with limited generic why-now when confidence permits.
Otherwise use uncertainty explanation naming only verified missing evidence.
Otherwise omit supplement/detail rather than inventing a reason.
